rep.angle: lead with a peer company's result
rep.name: Arjun

rep_lines.text: Hi Elena, Arjun at HyperSale. A peer team now catches coaching gaps weekly instead of at quarter-end. You requested a demo yesterday—good time?
Reps practise realistic buyer calls, and managers get weekly scoring tied to exact rep quotes. How do you train SDRs today?
Setup is typically lightweight, and we’d scope timing around your team and scenarios. How many SDRs are you training today?
Yes—managers see week-by-week trends, with each score linked to the exact quote behind it. Which cold-call skills are hardest for them today?
We can do it this week and tailor it to objection handling and openings for your five SDRs. Do mornings or afternoons work better?
Thursday morning works. What time and time zone suit you? Once confirmed, I’ll send an invite you can forward to your senior reps.
